# 一条公理推出 G0：Ren 的公理读作延续之意义的边界中立（Unrestricted）；在主张的意义即某形成在某步之延续的意义的每种读法上，G0、处处 S0、两条中立与种子由它推出，不用连通；在水平路径上 C 也推出；没有任何东西有意义时什么都不被定序，所以公理是需要的 / One axiom yields G0: Ren's axiom read as boundary neutrality for the significance of continuation (Unrestricted); on every reading in which a claim's significance is that of a formation's continuation at a step, G0, S0 at every standpoint, both neutralities and a seed follow from it with no connection used; on level paths C follows too; where nothing has significance nothing is ordered, so the axiom is needed

## 主张 Claim

一个意义 sig : Pos → Nat → F → Prop 对一个立场、一步与一个形成说：从该立场，该形成在该步的延续是否有意义。公理 Unrestricted sig 是对指标 (p, t, f) 的边界中立（Neutral）：从每个立场，任何东西在每一步的延续都有意义。以区域为界的意义（bounded region）是在各立场的区域之内接受同一规则（Within）；有形成在某个立场的区域之外时，它不是公理（bounded_rival）。设估值 V 中主张 c 从立场 p 的意义由形成 formation c 在步 step c 之延续的意义给出（reads）。公理之下，V 上的 G0（主张层面：每个活的主张从每个立场都有意义）成立，每个立场的 S0、N_rel 与 N_std 成立，有活的主张时种子存在，不用连通（Valuation.premises_of_unrestricted）。逐步读法（Web.valuation）、关系层读法（Web.relations）与整段读法（Conditions.valuation）都是这样的读法（Web.significant_of_unrestricted、Conditions.significant_of_unrestricted）。一个网的水平路径构成一个不走步的框架（Web.paths）：主张是某步的形成，在一条水平路径上被接纳即实现。公理之下，在这个框架上，对 living 的每种读法，G0 成立，其中正面意义读作从每个立场都有意义；C 也成立，其中“更好”读作从立场 p 保留且增加有意义者（Web.Retains 与 Web.Adds，Web.paths_g0_comparison）。没有任何东西有意义时，每条水平路径保留每一条、没有一条增加，逐步读法上的 G0 在任何活的事件上都不成立；一切都有意义时 G0 成立（Web.significance_undetermined）。不用 Lean 公理。 / A significance sig : Pos → Nat → F → Prop says, for a standpoint, a step and a formation, whether from the standpoint the formation's continuation at the step has significance. The axiom Unrestricted sig is boundary neutrality (Neutral) over the index (p, t, f): from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step. A significance bounded by regions (bounded region) accepts the same rule inside each standpoint's region (Within); where some formation lies outside some standpoint's region it is not the axiom (bounded_rival). Let a claim c's significance from standpoint p in a valuation V be given by that of formation c's continuation at step c (reads). Under the axiom, G0 on V at the level of claims (every living claim significant from every standpoint) holds, S0 at every standpoint, N_rel and N_std hold, and a seed exists where some claim lives, with no connection used (Valuation.premises_of_unrestricted). The stepwise reading (Web.valuation), the reading of relations (Web.relations) and the whole-run reading (Conditions.valuation) are such readings (Web.significant_of_unrestricted, Conditions.significant_of_unrestricted). A web's level paths form a frame that does not step (Web.paths): a claim is a formation at a step, realized along a level path when the levels admit it there. Under the axiom, on this frame and for every reading of living, G0 holds with positive significance read as significance from every standpoint, and so does C, with “better” read as retaining and adding what has significance from standpoint p (Web.Retains and Web.Adds, Web.paths_g0_comparison). Where nothing has significance, every level path retains every other and none adds, and G0 on the stepwise reading fails at any event that lives; where everything has significance G0 holds (Web.significance_undetermined). No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Significance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 公理：Unrestricted sig，即从每个立场，任何东西在每一步的延续都有意义（对指标 (p, t, f) 的边界中立）。它是定理的假设，不被证明；把它读作 Ren 的公理是 AI 的读法，待 Ren。 / The axiom: Unrestricted sig, that from every standpoint the continuation of anything has significance at every step (boundary neutrality over the index (p, t, f)). It is a hypothesis of the theorems and is not proved; reading it as Ren's axiom is the AI's reading, pending Ren.
- 对应：主张的意义读作某形成在某步之延续的意义（formation、step 与 reads）；不满足它的读法上，定理不说什么。 / Correspondence: a claim's significance is read as that of some formation's continuation at some step (formation, step and reads); on readings that do not meet it the theorem says nothing.
- C 只在水平路径的框架上推出；在一般的框架上 C 仍是前提。 / C follows only on the frame of level paths; on a general frame C remains a premise.
- 离散的步（从第零步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量；部分是可判定的家族（part : F → Bool）。 / Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; a part is a decided family (part : F → Bool).

Ren 的公理是“for anything, its continuation into the future has significance(doesn't have to be positive, we could argue as long as not harm), or continuation into the future needs to create more significance(being generative)”。Ren 又写道，中心及其边界只存在于认知的结构与动力学中，“so there isn't really who's continuation matters, which requires axiom”，并说“not harm”是“a phase transition with a clear boundary”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：形成的索引读“anything”，形成在一步的延续读“its continuation into the future”，立场的索引读“has significance”不加限定、没有哪个中心特殊；保留读“as long as not harm”，增加读“create more significance”。名称（Unrestricted、Retains、Adds、Preemption 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选。 / Ren's axiom is “for anything, its continuation into the future has significance(doesn't have to be positive, we could argue as long as not harm), or continuation into the future needs to create more significance(being generative)”. Ren also wrote that a center and its boundary exist only within cognitive structure and dynamics, “so there isn't really who's continuation matters, which requires axiom”, and that “not harm” is “a phase transition with a clear boundary”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): the formation index reads “anything”, a formation's continuation at a step reads “its continuation into the future”, and the standpoint index reads “has significance” unqualified, with no center privileged; retaining reads “as long as not harm”, and adding reads “create more significance”. The names (Unrestricted, Retains, Adds, Preemption and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 34 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The axiom Unrestricted is a hypothesis of the theorems, not a Lean axiom. The author's counterreview is in §53 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

G0 在主张层面是公理的直接推论：G0 是公理限于活的主张，公理更强，因为它还覆盖不活的事件与尚未形成的形成；不证明公理本身，不给出它的规范根据；从意义到理由的一步（A）、提升（L）与实践判断（J1–J4）仍是前提；不推出义务、排序、认识、动机或遵循；C 只在水平路径上推出；意义不分等级，不给混合的部分定序；把 Unrestricted 读作 Ren 的公理是 AI 的读法，待 Ren；在 Ren 接受这条公理替代 G0 之前，G0 仍是所采用的公理。 / G0 at the level of claims is an immediate consequence of the axiom: G0 is the axiom restricted to living claims, and the axiom is stronger, covering events that are not living and formations not yet formed; the axiom itself is not proved and its normative warrant is not given; the step from significance to a reason (A), the lifting (L) and practical judgment (J1–J4) remain premises; no duty, ranking, recognition, motivation or compliance is inferred; C follows only on level paths; significance is not graded and orders no mixed part; reading Unrestricted as Ren's axiom is the AI's reading, pending Ren; until Ren accepts this axiom in G0's place, G0 remains the adopted axiom.

- 公理是需要的：没有任何东西有意义时，每条水平路径保留每一条、没有一条增加，G0 在任何活的事件上不成立（Web.significance_undetermined）；动力学不决定意义。 / The axiom is needed: where nothing has significance, every level path retains every other, none adds, and G0 fails at any event that lives (Web.significance_undetermined); the dynamics does not decide significance.
